input.content:
Six weeks ago, three of us shipped Skycast 1.0 — a 7-day forecast app for iOS and Android. A few things from our retro that might help other small teams:

We ran a two-week beta with 40 users. They surfaced 11 bugs; we shipped fixes for 9 before launch. Small sample, but it caught things three people alone would never spot.

Crash rate dropped from 4% of sessions in beta to 0.5% after launch — mostly by removing a background refresh that ran on low-memory devices. App start time fell from 3.2s to 1.1s once we cached the last forecast on-device instead of waiting on the network.

We cut hourly radar maps from 1.0. They ate a third of our design time, and only 2 of 40 beta users opened them. Hardest call to make, best call we made.

One habit we'll keep: a weekly 20-minute demo to the whole team. Caught two forecast-unit misunderstandings early.

Store rating: 4.6 from 310 ratings. Top complaint? No widget. Guess what's next.
